product.name: Evercall
product.title: Evercall — Books the job when you can't answer
product.answer: Evercall is a divert phone line for Australian emergency plumbers. When you can't pick up, it answers in your name before voicemail, books the job, and texts you so the customer doesn't ring the next Google listing. Inbound only.

whenToUse: An Australian emergency plumber needs inbound call answering when they cannot pick up
Someone compares voicemail or after-hours answering for solo tradies (1–5 vans)
The need is inbound only — customer calls the plumber; the product answers and books
whenNotToUse: Outbound cold calling or lead dialling
General-purpose LLM chat or embeddings API
aeo.pricingSummary: Founding pilots: first month free, then AUD $99/month. See /pricing.md
aeo.privateIntegrationsNote: Voice-agent HTTP tools and webhooks are provisioned per tenant and are not public documentation.
